description: Terminal coding agents through their vendors' curl installers: Maki, Devin CLI, Oh My Pi, Warp Agent CLI and Kilo CLI.
why: Each agent has one witness here: ~/.local/bin/maki, ~/.local/bin/devin, ~/.omp, which omp writes when run, ~/.local/bin/warp, and ~/.kilo, which Kilo's installer creates for its binary. ~/.local/bin/omp is on disk, which must_contain holds, and is evidence for nothing, which forbid_evidence holds, so the Oh My Pi finding is ~/.omp's alone; removing any of the five values turns must_find red. Oh My Pi is a fork of Pi, so pi and openclaw (built on Pi's libraries) are forbidden; windsurf because its cask is devin-desktop; claude-code and codex-cli because ~/.local/bin and top-level home directories are their routes too; opencode because Kilo's CLI forks it and its installer writes the same shape of directory, and cline and roo-code because Kilo Code forks them.
known_gaps: Maki's, Devin CLI's and Oh My Pi's Windows installers are not exercised; Warp's and Kilo's are 110-windows-installers-more's.
